content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Compose State and Events** as part of **Kotlin for Android Development**. Compose UI is a function of state; state ownership, events, and recomposition boundaries affect correctness and performance. Use the subtopics—State and Recomposition, State Hoisting, Handling User Events—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Android code must account for lifecycle changes, accessibility, UI state, and platform APIs. Isolating business logic makes the interface easier to test.
